svg.title: Real depreciation follows different national paths
svg.desc: Monthly real effective depreciation paths for Great Britain, Czechoslovakia, Belgium and France, 1928–1936. Each series is the chained log effective rate minus its January 1929 value, multiplied by 100. Upward movements indicate depreciation. Annual bilateral total-trade weights enter with a one-year lag. Vertical markers identify September 1931, February 1934, April 1935 and October 1936. Missing observations are left as gaps: France has no value for January 1928 or January 1930 through January 1931.
